### Popover

```ts
const Popover: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & object & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>;
```

A non-modal raised panel attached to its PopoverAnchor. It never takes focus, so
the anchored control (for example a composer) keeps typing while the popover
lists suggestions.
